import pandas as pd
from sqlalchemy import text

# Build the SQL query to compute Voronoi, clip to bbox, and get areas
query = text("""
WITH station_points AS (
    SELECT id, name_en, coordinate::geometry as geom
    FROM air_quality_station
),
bbox AS (
    SELECT ST_SetSRID(ST_MakeBox2D(
        ST_MakePoint(MIN(ST_X(geom)), MIN(ST_Y(geom))),
        ST_MakePoint(MAX(ST_X(geom)), MAX(ST_Y(geom)))
    ), 4326) as box
    FROM station_points
),
voronoi AS (
    SELECT id, name_en, (ST_Dump(ST_VoronoiPolygons(ST_Collect(geom)))).geom as cell_geom
    FROM station_points
),
clipped AS (
    SELECT v.id, v.name_en, ST_Intersection(v.cell_geom, b.box) as clipped_geom
    FROM voronoi v, bbox b
)
SELECT id, name_en, ST_Area(clipped_geom::geography) / 1e6 as area_km2
FROM clipped
ORDER BY area_km2 ASC
""")
result = pd.read_sql(query, engine)
print(result)

import pandas as pd
from sqlalchemy import text

# Build the SQL query to compute Voronoi, clip to bbox, and get areas
query = text("""
WITH station_points AS (
    SELECT id, name_en, coordinate::geometry as geom
    FROM air_quality_station
),
bbox AS (
    SELECT ST_SetSRID(ST_MakeBox2D(
        ST_MakePoint(MIN(ST_X(geom)), MIN(ST_Y(geom))),
        ST_MakePoint(MAX(ST_X(geom)), MAX(ST_Y(geom)))
    ), 4326) as box
    FROM station_points
),
voronoi_cells AS (
    SELECT (ST_Dump(ST_VoronoiPolygons(ST_Collect(geom)))).geom as cell_geom
    FROM station_points
),
clipped AS (
    SELECT v.cell_geom, ST_Intersection(v.cell_geom, b.box) as clipped_geom
    FROM voronoi_cells v, bbox b
),
matched AS (
    SELECT sp.id, sp.name_en, c.clipped_geom,
           ST_Area(c.clipped_geom::geography) / 1e6 as area_km2
    FROM clipped c
    JOIN station_points sp ON sp.id = (
        SELECT sp2.id FROM station_points sp2
        ORDER BY ST_Distance(sp2.geom, ST_Centroid(c.clipped_geom))
        LIMIT 1
    )
)
SELECT id, name_en, ROUND(area_km2, 1) as area_km2
FROM matched
ORDER BY area_km2 ASC
""")
result = pd.read_sql(query, engine)
print(result)

import pandas as pd
from sqlalchemy import text
import numpy as np

# Step 1: Get all 18 station coordinates
query = text("""
SELECT id, name_en, ST_X(coordinate::geometry) as lon, ST_Y(coordinate::geometry) as lat
FROM air_quality_station
ORDER BY id
""")
stations = pd.read_sql(query, engine)
print(f"Total stations: {len(stations)}")
print(stations[['id', 'name_en', 'lon', 'lat']])

from sqlalchemy import text

# Compute bounding box of all stations
min_lon = stations['lon'].min()
max_lon = stations['lon'].max()
min_lat = stations['lat'].min()
max_lat = stations['lat'].max()

print(f"Bounding box: lon [{min_lon}, {max_lon}], lat [{min_lat}, {max_lat}]")

# Create Voronoi diagram using PostGIS, clip to bbox, and compute areas
query = text(f"""
WITH station_points AS (
    SELECT id, name_en, coordinate::geometry as geom
    FROM air_quality_station
),
voronoi AS (
    SELECT (ST_Dump(ST_VoronoiPolygons(ST_Collect(geom)))).geom as cell_geom,
           sp.id as station_id,
           sp.name_en as station_name
    FROM station_points sp
    JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT (ST_Dump(ST_VoronoiPolygons(ST_Collect(sp2.geom)))).geom as cell_geom
        FROM station_points sp2
    ) v ON TRUE
    WHERE ST_Intersects(v.cell_geom, sp.geom)
),
clipped AS (
    SELECT station_id, station_name,
           ST_Intersection(cell_geom, 
               ST_MakeEnvelope({min_lon}, {min_lat}, {max_lon}, {max_lat}, 4326)
           ) as clipped_geom
    FROM voronoi
    WHERE cell_geom IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT station_id, station_name,
       ST_Area(clipped_geom::geography) / 1000000.0 as area_km2
FROM clipped
ORDER BY area_km2 ASC
""")

result = pd.read_sql(query, engine)
print(f"Number of cells computed: {len(result)}")
print(result)

from sqlalchemy import text

query = text(f"""
WITH station_points AS (
    SELECT id, name_en, coordinate::geometry as geom
    FROM air_quality_station
),
voronoi_cells AS (
    SELECT (ST_Dump(ST_VoronoiPolygons(ST_Collect(geom)))).geom as cell_geom
    FROM station_points
),
station_cells AS (
    SELECT sp.id as station_id, 
           sp.name_en as station_name,
           vc.cell_geom
    FROM station_points sp
    JOIN voronoi_cells vc ON ST_Contains(vc.cell_geom, sp.geom)
),
clipped AS (
    SELECT station_id, station_name,
           ST_Intersection(cell_geom, 
               ST_MakeEnvelope({min_lon}, {min_lat}, {max_lon}, {max_lat}, 4326)
           ) as clipped_geom
    FROM station_cells
)
SELECT station_id, station_name,
       ST_Area(clipped_geom::geography) / 1000000.0 as area_km2
FROM clipped
ORDER BY area_km2 ASC
""")

result = pd.read_sql(query, engine)
print(f"Number of cells computed: {len(result)}")
print(result)
